headline: Catalan separatist Carles Puigdemont announces return to Spain after nearly a decade in exile
label: NEWS
caption:
Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont is heading back home after years away. 🇪🇸

According to Al Jazeera, former regional leader Carles Puigdemont has announced he will return to Spain on December 12 and end nearly a decade of self imposed exile. Speaking at a news conference in Brussels, he stated that he will unveil a proposal for a renewed Catalan independence push on December 17.

Puigdemont fled to Belgium in October 2017 after organising an independence referendum that Spanish courts deemed illegal. That event triggered Spain's worst political crisis in decades and deepened tensions between Madrid and Catalonia.

He previously made a brief return to Spain in August 2024 to deliver a defiant speech in Barcelona before disappearing and prompting a police operation. His upcoming return follows an amnesty approved by parliament in 2024 as part of a deal between Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez and Catalan separatist groups.

Will this move spark a new political crisis in Spain? 👇
